steps: (async () => { const pause = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); const step = Math.round(innerHeight * 0.8); const max = () => document.documentElement.scrollHeight - innerHeight; for (let y = 0; y <= max(); y += step) { scrollTo(0, y); await pause(160); } scrollTo(0, max()); await pause(400); scrollTo(0, 0); await pause(700); return 'scrolled ' + document.documentElement.scrollHeight; })()
